rda_taxon_links.link_evidence: Korean standard name 참굴 = Crassostrea gigas (e.g., KCI ART001166457 title '참굴, Crassostrea gigas'); RDA English 'Pacific oyster'; WoRMS accepted Magallana gigas 836033.
우렁쉥이 is the Korean standard name of Halocynthia roretzi; WoRMS 250680 vernacular 'Korean common sea squirt' matches the RDA English name.
미역 (sea mustard/wakame) = Undaria pinnatifida; WoRMS 145721 vernacular 'wakame'.
참담치 = Mytilus coruscus (hard-shelled mussel); RDA keeps separate rows for 진주담치 and 지중해담치, so this row is species-specific.
살오징어 = Todarodes pacificus (Japanese common squid). The generic '오징어, 생것' row is NOT linked.
톳 (hijiki) = Sargassum fusiforme (syn. Hizikia fusiformis); RDA English 'Seaweed fusiforme'.
Korean name and English 'Ceylon moss' are agar-weed labels without species identification; not assigned to Gelidium elegans 372119.
Generic 'sea cucumber' row; not assignable to Apostichopus japonicus 241776 without specimen identification.
넙치 is the Korean standard name of Paralichthys olivaceus; 'Bastard halibut' is its FAO English name.
조피볼락 = Sebastes schlegelii ('Korean rockfish'); RDA keeps separate rows for the other 볼락 species.
참조기 is the Korean standard name of Larimichthys polyactis; the English 'Yellow croaker' is looser than the Korean name (L. crocea is 부세).
큰가리비 = Mizuhopecten (Patinopecten) yessoensis, English 'Yesso scallop'; other scallop species have their own rows.
바지락 = Ruditapes philippinarum (Japanese littleneck/Manila clam).
Farm-raised row of the same species (바지락).
꽃게 is the Korean standard name of Portunus trituberculatus; 민꽃게 (Charybdis japonica) has a separate row. The English 'Blue crab' is a loose translation.
방어 = Seriola quinqueradiata (Japanese amberjack/yellowtail); farmed young-fish row borrowed from the Japanese table JAPAN('20).
멸치 = Engraulis japonicus, the only anchovy named 멸치 in Korean waters.
대구 = Gadus macrocephalus ('Pacific cod'); 빨간대구 and 은대구 are separate rows.
둥근전복 = Haliotis discus discus ('Disk abalone'), a subspecies of the candidate species.
피조개 is the Korean standard name of Anadara (Scapharca) broughtonii.
참갑오징어 'Golden cuttlefish' = Sepia esculenta, WoRMS synonym of Acanthosepion esculentum.
청각 is the Korean standard name of Codium fragile ('Sea staghorn').
Generic 'Mackerel' row; Korean market 고등어 can include Scomber australasicus (망치고등어). Not assigned to S. japonicus.
Generic 'Brown kelp' label; not assigned to Saccharina japonica without specimen identification.
꼬시래기 was historically labelled Gracilaria verrucosa in Korea; not assigned to G. vermiculophylla without specimen identification.
'Common octopus' is Octopus vulgaris; the East Asian population is now O. sinensis, but the row does not state which. Not assigned.
Generic 'Cuttle fish' row; the species-specific 참갑오징어 row is linked instead.
